lines.t: (Verse 1)
Golden light on the shoreline breeze
Palm trees swayin’, hearts at ease
Sand between my feet, I feel alive
Every wave reminds me why
Sky so wide, painted blue
All creation sings of You
In the warmth, I hear Your call
You’ve been with me through it all
(Pre-Chorus)
Every sunrise, mercy new
Every heartbeat leads to You
(Chorus)
In the summer light, I’m runnin’ free
Your love shining down on me
Like the ocean wide, it never ends
You’re my Savior and my Friend
YahuShua, You light my way
Brighter than the longest day
In this season, I can see
You’re the life inside of me
(Verse 2)
Bonfire nights and stars above
Feel the fire of Your love
Through the laughter, through the song
You’ve been there all along
Warm winds carry peace so deep
Even when the shadows creep
I don’t fear what I can’t see
Your truth is anchoring me
(Pre-Chorus)
Every sunrise, mercy new
Every heartbeat leads to You
(Chorus)
In the summer light, I’m runnin’ free
Your love shining down on me
Like the ocean wide, it never ends
You’re my Savior and my Friend
You light my way
Brighter than the longest day
In this season, I can see
You’re the life inside of me
(Bridge)
Even when the seasons change
You remain, You stay the same
Through the calm and through the flame
Forever I’ll praise Your name
(Chorus – Final)
In the summer light, I’m runnin’ free
Your love shining down on me
Like the ocean wide, it never ends
You’re my Savior and my Friend, You light my way
Brighter than the longest day
In every season, I will sing
You’re my hope, my everything
